summary: A twice-monthly (2nd and 4th Mondays) silent reading gathering at Character Study, a West Asheville literary cocktail bar, organized by Otterpine, a local indie author support/publishing agency, running September through December 2026. It follows the well-established 'silent reading party' / 'silent book club' format found in many cities, where an hour of quiet co-reading (books, e-readers, audiobooks, or quiet crafts) is followed by optional socializing, explicitly framed as low-pressure and introvert-friendly rather than a one-off event.
